John dashed to the front, ostentatiously asked for guidance out of the grounds, and disappeared up Saffron Lane shoulder to shoulder with Mike Fuller - Fowler, Haslam, Francis and Kirkham in hot pursuit.
With M. Fuller proving a surprise winner it was realised that Hercules-Wimb. also had their 3rd scoring man in before us, and so beat us for second place with an equal number of points.
Bivens of Ealing was the leader and Mike Fuller brought Hercules up to 4th. John Thresher on Stage three took us up to 2nd and gained a few seconds on Ealing who were still out in front.
Our rivals had another "ace" in Mike Fuller, but Trevor isn't put off by tough opponents, and although he did concede 27secs he handed over a lead of nearly 2 minutes to John Thresher.

John Bicourt had a close battle for second place in the 5,000m. with Mike Fuller (Hercules Wimbledon), and although squeezed into third position, can be said to have run well, since he had been sixth in the 1,500m. less than an hour-and-a-half before.

Also to be seen are Chris Wade of Ranelagh (brother of tennis star Virginia), no. 11 Adrian Major (Belgrave) who placed 5th, no. 77, Mick Fuller (Hercules Wimbledon) and we can just spot Bob Gevers (SLH).
